title: NOMA
tagline: NOMA is not only tool for experiencing, NOMA are the best company for any nomad at world.
description:
NOMA is a social travel app that connects digital nomads with real local experiences hosted by verified people around the world.
From home-cooked dinners to cultural workshops, users can book both free and paid activities, all with the option to pay in crypto for a fast, global, borderless experience.
With World ID verification ensuring safer connections, NOMA makes it easy to discover authentic activities, meet locals and travelers, and access unique community-driven moments wherever you go.
